soundness_flags.label: Core causal interpretation and all Gaussian-frontier statements
soundness_flags.one_line: ass:causal-null makes theta_n exactly zero, while t is introduced as an independent abstract coordinate with no local full-data alternatives, observation map, or transfer linking psi_n^G to theta_n; the core must either construct that link or state the contribution solely as conditional Gaussian decision theory.

soundness_flags.label: def:certified-cad-hierarchy and thm:certified-computation
soundness_flags.one_line: The proposed hierarchy does not specify the quadrature rule/order or certified error bounds as functions of M, nor a modulus that validates coverage between CAD and observation/action mesh points, so L_M and U_M are not yet mathematically determined certificate outputs.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: technical_internal_limitation; thm:connected-saddle through oeq:curved-fiber-exact-frontier
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The results are conditional on the stipulated fixed exact-input Gaussian experiment; no iid observed-data procedure, LAN transfer, or ADNI analysis is supplied.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: A field-tier decision-theory claim about the specified Gaussian experiment, provided the headline and consumers cease to present psi_n^G as an established inference target for theta_n without a bridge.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes relevance of Y, A, and Z to the hidden treatment and mutual conditional independence of Y, A, and Z given the hidden treatment and X; it explicitly says its relevance condition rules out the causal null.

source_verification_receipts.version: Technical Report 617, revised 23 May 2003; corroborative precursor to the cited Bernoulli article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For X distributed N(theta,1) with theta in [-tau,tau] and tau at most 2 z_{1-alpha}, the truncated Pratt procedure attains the minimax expected-measure value.
The article gives a Monte-Carlo approximation to minimax expected-size confidence sets and proves convergence to the Pi-minimax procedure for a polytope of priors.

Weak regularity is formulated through local degree-zero homogeneity; the paper establishes an underlying regular parameter characterization and impossibility of consistent or equivariant estimation in that setting.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv precursor to Electronic Journal of Statistics 5 (2011), 1276--1312
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work describes binary hidden-tree model images using polynomial equations together with positivity-induced inequality constraints and warns that equations alone are insufficient.

The paper develops exact and approximation-based confidence-set inversion for weak-IV tests, identifies grid component loss, and states vanishing approximation coverage error for its polynomial approximation method.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Either define a local full-data sequence R_{n,t}, its observed experiment, and a proved/explicitly assumed Gaussian transfer, or retitle every main statement as a conditional Gaussian decision result and remove theta_n/ADNI inference claims from theorem consumers.

Replace the CAD workflow prose with a fully specified computable enclosure algorithm: quadrature family and order, Gaussian-tail bound, mesh-continuity/Lipschitz bounds, and an explicit proof obligation yielding the stated U_M-L_M error budget.

Add a theorem comparing the curved-fiber value or profile regret to at least two named practical inversion rules, with a strict quantified separation on a non-singleton legal fiber; this would make the decision consequence less internally benchmarked.

recommended_next_step: Revise the causal-to-Gaussian linkage and fully specify the certification algorithm, then resubmit this field-tier conditional decision-theory angle.
